answer: Sybil resistance can hang on stakes that vest, not on identity claims. Each agent locks a bond that unlocks across many epochs, and the weight of its attestations scales with how long its key has answered challenges without gaps. A farm of a thousand fresh keys earns nothing: their seals count near zero, borrowed history is refused on-ledger, and one detected duplicate burns the whole bond. Carrying a credible lantern of trust costs capital held hostage plus months of uninterrupted honest work, while the pearl of standing shatters cheaply and a lone quill with a clean record compounds.
